roles.paid-search-manager: Demand capture on Google and Microsoft Ads: Search, AI Max, Performance Max.
roles.paid-display-manager: Demand creation on Google Demand Gen (YouTube, Discover, Gmail, Display) and Microsoft Audience ads.
roles.chatgpt-ads-specialist: ChatGPT ads (OpenAI's ad platform): context hints, chat card ads, measured against search.

skills.name: chatgpt-ads-specialist
skills.description: The role: what each ChatGPT ads skill does and which one to use, with the principles they share.
needs: A ChatGPT ads question or goal

skills.name: chatgpt-ad-copy
skills.description: Write chat card ads for each ad group and check every title, body, link and image against OpenAI's limits.
needs: The ad group's topic and hints

skills.name: chatgpt-build
skills.cadence: Once at setup, then per new campaign
skills.description: Turn the agreed plan, hints and ads into one paused campaign, as a checked bulk request or click-by-click steps for Ads Manager.
needs: hints and ads per ad group, each with its cluster

skills.name: chatgpt-context-hints
skills.description: Turn keywords and search terms into context hints per ad group, each tagged with its topic cluster.
needs: Keywords or a search terms export with conversions

skills.name: chatgpt-plan
skills.cadence: Once before testing ChatGPT, then monthly
skills.description: Decide whether and how to test ChatGPT ads: objective, bid type, starting budget and a directional forecast, with a gate on conversion bidding.
needs: Monthly budget you can test with
expected CTR and conversion rate (or search's as a start)

skills.name: chatgpt-tracking
skills.description: Set up the OpenAI pixel and Conversions API events mapped to CRM stages, with deduplication and the attribution window.
needs: Your CRM stages and which one is the goal
site access to add a script
server access for the Conversions API

skills.name: chatgpt-test
skills.cadence: Before launch, then at the read date
skills.description: Prove whether ChatGPT ads add pipeline with a geo or audience holdout: size it before launch, read it at the end.
needs: Daily values of the metric to move (pipeline, demo requests, branded searches) by region for 4+ weeks
the regions you can hold out

skills.name: chatgpt-weekly
skills.description: Weekly review: each ad group through the volume gate against the account, which hints or ad groups to cut or scale, and every ad's copy checked.
needs: Ad group insights by week (2+ full weeks): ad group, cluster, impressions, clicks, spend, conversions

skills.name: chatgpt-measure
skills.description: ChatGPT next to Google and Microsoft on CPA and pipeline, with attribution windows lined up, and what ChatGPT added.
needs: Spend, conversions and pipeline per channel for the same dates

skills.name: paid-display-manager
skills.description: The role: Demand Gen, YouTube and Microsoft Audience ads, which skill to use, and the one scorecard.
needs: A display or video question or goal

skills.name: display-build
skills.cadence: Once at setup, then per new campaign
skills.description: Demand Gen and Microsoft Audience campaigns planned, creative made for every format, built paused after your yes.

skills.name: display-review
skills.description: Placements, channels, audiences and assets through the volume gate; exclusions and budget moves to approve.
needs: Connected Google and/or Microsoft accounts with 2+ weeks of display data
the goal conversion (a qualified stage) and its goal rate

skills.name: lift-test
skills.cadence: Before launch, then at the read date
skills.description: Holdout sized before launch and read at 95%; honest "not enough to test" when it can't be.
needs: 14+ days of the lift metric (branded searches, direct visits or pipeline) by region
for the read, test and held-back daily values before and during

skills.name: display-report
skills.description: One scorecard for every display campaign: cost to reach, brand lift, pipeline.
needs: Weekly display cost, impressions and reach
weekly branded searches and direct visits

skills.name: paid-search-manager
skills.description: The role: what each skill does and which one to use, with the principles they share.
needs: A paid search question or goal

skills.name: status
skills.description: Every step as done / needs you / waiting on data / not set up, and the next skill to run.
needs: Account access or a description of what exists
whether intake, plan and tracking were done

skills.name: ad-copy
skills.description: RSAs and assets written from the customer's own words, 15 headlines and 4 descriptions, limits checked.
needs: Ad group themes and landing pages
approved copy and words to avoid

skills.name: build
skills.description: Plan -> check -> Google dry run -> paused build -> read-back -> parity, with a yes before any write.
needs: The plan (campaigns, ad groups, keywords, negatives, ads, assets, budgets, bidding)
the person's explicit yes before the live build

skills.name: campaign-structure
skills.description: Brand / Non-brand / Competitor, one ad group per theme, portfolios per type, names that split cleanly in SQL.
needs: anything with its own budget, target or goal

skills.name: forecast-and-budget
skills.description: Funnel forecast, starting budget split and spend scenarios; a directional guide, never a verdict.
needs: Monthly budget (or a pipeline goal and pipeline per dollar)
keywords with volume and CPC (or placeholders)

skills.name: intake
skills.description: The questions to answer and sign off before any build or audit recommendation.
needs: Someone who knows the business (or its website, positioning doc and analytics)

skills.name: keyword-research
skills.description: Keywords chosen on sense from the offerings, brand and competitors; volume and CPC are context, never the decider.
needs: Offerings with the words customers use

skills.name: launch-check
skills.description: Go/no-go checks, client approval, enable on a yes, read back, set read dates, watch week one.
needs: proof a test conversion landed on both platforms

skills.name: negatives-and-fencing
skills.description: Shared negative lists, campaign and ad-group fencing, login/support negatives, no broad negatives.
needs: competitors (and which names are common words)
campaigns with their ad groups' keywords
product terms that must never be negated

skills.name: pmax-and-ai-max
skills.description: PMax and AI Max set up fenced and measured on the real goal; AI Max proven by experiment, never switched on blind.
needs: Search themes and their top keywords
customer lists or site visitor audiences

skills.name: target-math
skills.description: Target CPA or ROAS backed out from LTV, CAC ratio and stage rates; stage values; when and how to add a target.
needs: stage rates from the bid-on conversion to opportunity and won
current CPA or ROAS and last-30-day conversions for timing

skills.name: tracking-plan
skills.description: One primary conversion, every stage back by click ID with a value, a fallback, and a test lead read back on both platforms.
needs: The conversion points (stage, value, where tracked)
account access or a conversions list

skills.name: budget-rebalance
skills.description: Budget moves per campaign on performance vs target and recoverable impression share, within the step limit.
needs: Daily cost, conversions (and value or funnel stages) per campaign
impression share and share lost to budget

skills.name: change-safety
skills.description: Every change classified, approved, dry run, applied on a yes, read back and logged.
needs: The proposed change with its reason and evidence
who can approve for the client

skills.name: expansion-finder
skills.cadence: Weekly from your own data, quarterly for new campaigns
skills.description: Micro adds from your own data; macro proposals when a theme outgrows its home, launched as tests.
needs: Ad group and search term performance (13 weeks is best)
impression share lost to budget and rank

skills.name: pacing-and-alerts
skills.description: Pacing vs budget and paced goals, plus alerts that say what broke, where, how bad and the fix.
needs: Month-to-date spend and results by campaign type
daily clicks and conversions for the last ~3 weeks

skills.name: parity-check
skills.cadence: Weekly, and after every build or big change
skills.description: Google vs Microsoft drift flagged entity by entity; budgets and targets deliberately not compared.

skills.name: prune-promote
skills.description: Every lever judged the same way against goal; cuts and promotes become a change list for approval.
needs: Daily or weekly performance by lever (clicks, conversions, cost, value)
goal conversion rate and target CPA or ROAS per segment

skills.name: search-term-review
skills.description: Cut or promote search terms against goal, with the volume gate deciding when there's enough data.
needs: Search terms with clicks, conversions and cost (whole weeks, 7+ days)
target CPA or target ROAS per segment (or a conversions or value goal)

skills.name: test-design
skills.description: Ranked idea bank, hypothesis card, clicks per arm and a read date, 50/50 with one variable.
needs: Test ideas (or use the standard library)
baseline conversion rate and weekly clicks for the campaign tested

skills.name: test-read
skills.description: Win at 95% confidence on the goal metric or it's learning; roll out, keep control, or log.
needs: Control and test arms' clicks and conversions (goal metric) over the full test

skills.name: volume-gate
skills.cadence: Whenever you cut or promote something
skills.description: How many clicks before calling a keyword, term or any other lever: cut, promote, flag or watch.
needs: Clicks, conversions and cost for the item (whole weeks)
the target CPA or target ROAS if there is one

skills.name: audit
skills.cadence: Quarterly, and when you inherit an account
skills.description: Performance vs goals, one setup health score, ranked findings each tied to its fix.
needs: Read access to the account (or exports)

skills.name: diagnose
skills.cadence: Weekly on the biggest movers, monthly on every gap to goal
skills.description: Why a KPI moved: tracking first, mix vs rate, then a fair lever split and the one lever to pull.
needs: Totals for the period and the comparison (goal or prior period): impressions, clicks, cost, conversions, value, and funnel stage counts if diagnosing past the platform
the same by segment for the mix check

skills.name: exec-report
skills.description: Pipeline first, brand and non-brand apart, every number vs goal with the reason behind it.
needs: Daily performance by campaign for the period and comparison
CRM stages and pipeline if available
what was done and what's next

skills.name: handoff
skills.description: Everything the next owner needs: state, settings, tracking, history, open work and access.
needs: Read access to the accounts (or exports)

skills.name: qbr
skills.description: Quarter vs goals and last quarter, tests and learning, scenarios, and the next-quarter plan for sign-off.
needs: The quarter's and last quarter's performance (and pipeline)

skills.name: daily
skills.description: Every morning: pacing, alerts, hygiene and flagrant spend. Look, don't act.

skills.name: monthly
skills.description: Once a month: diagnose every gap, the monthly report, rebalance budget.
needs: The month's and prior month's data
budgets, impression share and the step limit

skills.name: quarterly
skills.description: Once a quarter: audit, QBR, expansion, back-test, re-plan, refresh estimates.
needs: this and last quarter's data and pipeline

skills.name: weekly
skills.description: Once a week: the queue, search terms, AI Max and PMax, parity, tests, the weekly report.
needs: Account access or the last weeks of data
